📚 1. 15 Từ Vựng Cốt Lõi (Kèm Phát Âm Audio Bản Xứ)

Bấm vào nút 🔊 để nghe phát âm chuẩn bản xứ của từng từ vựng (trên iPhone, hãy gạt cần rung sang chế độ Chuông để bật loa ngoài). Hệ thống tối ưu hiển thị linh hoạt trên cả điện thoại, máy tính bảng và máy tính:

⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. destination (n)
/ˌdestɪˈneɪʃn/
điểm đến du lịch
Collocation: popular tourist destination, holiday destination
"Ha Long Bay is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Southeast Asia."
2. heritage (n)
/ˈherɪtɪdʒ/
di sản (văn hóa, lịch sử, thiên nhiên)
Collocation: cultural heritage, UNESCO World Heritage site
"Every citizen has a duty to protect our nation's rich cultural heritage."
3. itinerary (n)
/aɪˈtɪnərəri/
lịch trình chuyến đi chi tiết
Collocation: travel itinerary, plan a three-day itinerary
"Our tour guide sent us the full travel itinerary before we arrived in Rome."
4. hospitality (n)
/ˌhɒspɪˈtæləti/
lòng hiếu khách, sự tiếp đón nồng hậu
Collocation: warm hospitality, local hospitality industry
"International visitors are always impressed by the warm hospitality of local villagers."
5. indigenous (adj)
/ɪnˈdɪdʒənəs/
bản địa, thuộc về cư dân/văn hóa gốc tại địa phương
Collocation: indigenous people, indigenous culture
"Ecotourism projects help indigenous communities earn a stable income."
6. fragile (adj)
/ˈfrædʒaɪl/
mong manh, dễ bị tổn thương/hư hại (hệ sinh thái, di tích)
Collocation: fragile coral reef, fragile ancient monument
"Strict rules are needed to protect fragile coral reefs from mass tourism."
7. landmark (n)
/ˈlændmɑːk/
địa danh nổi tiếng, công trình biểu tượng
Collocation: historic landmark, iconic city landmark
"The Eiffel Tower is the most recognizable historic landmark in Paris."
8. custom (n)
/ˈkʌstəm/
phong tục, tập quán truyền thống
Collocation: local custom, respect traditional customs
"Foreign travellers should dress modestly to respect local customs at temples."
9. excursion (n)
/ɪkˈskɜːʃn/
chuyến tham quan dã ngoại ngắn trong ngày
Collocation: day excursion, boat excursion
"Our hotel organized a guided boat excursion to the nearby volcanic island."
10. spectacular (adj)
/spekˈtækjələ(r)/
hùng vĩ, ngoạn mục, đẹp choáng ngợp
Collocation: spectacular scenery, spectacular mountain view
"Hikers woke up early to watch the spectacular sunrise over the mountains."
11. authentic (adj)
/ɔːˈθentɪk/
đích thực, nguyên bản (ẩm thực, trải nghiệm văn hóa)
Collocation: authentic local cuisine, authentic experience
"Staying with a host family gives travellers an authentic cultural experience."
12. souvenir (n)
/ˌsuːvəˈnɪə(r)/
đồ lưu niệm mua khi đi du lịch
Collocation: handmade souvenir, buy souvenirs
"Buying handmade souvenirs directly from artisans supports the local economy."
13. respectful (adj)
/rɪˈspektfl/
tôn trọng, có thái độ lễ phép và ý thức giữ gìn
Collocation: respectful of local traditions, respectful behaviour
"Responsible tourists are always respectful of wildlife and historical sites."
14. regulate (v)
/ˈreɡjuleɪt/
điều tiết, quản lý bằng quy định pháp luật
Collocation: strictly regulate, regulate visitor numbers
"National parks must regulate daily visitor numbers to prevent littering."
15. expedition (n)
/ˌekspəˈdɪʃn/
chuyến thám hiểm, hành trình khảo sát
Collocation: scientific expedition, jungle expedition
"Biologists led a two-week expedition into the rainforest to study rare birds."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Động Từ Khuyết Thiếu Chỉ Lời Khuyên & Nghĩa Vụ: Should, Ought to, Must, Have to)

• Đưa ra lời khuyên & Đề xuất giải pháp (Advice/Recommendation): should / ought to + V-bare
  Ví dụ: Tourists should respect local customs and buy authentic handmade souvenirs.

• Nghĩa vụ bắt buộc & Quy định pháp luật (Strong Obligation): must / have to + V-bare
  - must not (mustn't) + V-bare: Cấm đoán tuyệt đối.
  - do not have to + V-bare: Không cần thiết / Không bắt buộc.
  Ví dụ: Visitors must not touch fragile ancient landmarks in the museum.

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Cấu Trúc Bị Động Với Động Từ Khuyết Thiếu Trong Writing Task 2)

• Công thức: S + should / must / ought to + be + V3/ed
  Đây là cấu trúc vàng để viết đoạn văn nêu Giải pháp (Solutions) trong IELTS Writing Task 2 mà không bị lặp chủ ngữ People / Governments.
  Ví dụ 1: Daily tourist numbers must be strictly regulated to protect fragile ecosystems.
  Ví dụ 2: Indigenous cultural heritage should be preserved for future generations.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Hoi An Ancient Town is a famous UNESCO World ________ site in central Vietnam.
2. Before flying to Japan, we planned a detailed seven-day travel ________.
3. Coral reefs are extremely ________ ecosystems that can easily be damaged by boat anchors.
4. Foreign travellers should learn about local ________ so they do not offend anyone.
5. From the top of the mountain, hikers enjoyed a ________ view of the emerald valley.
6. Instead of eating at international fast-food chains, we tried ________ street food cooked by locals.
7. The villagers welcomed us into their homes with warm ________ and fresh herbal tea.
8. Authorities must ________ the number of cruise ships entering the bay each day.
9. We booked a half-day boat ________ to visit the floating fishing village.
10. Tourists should be ________ when taking photographs inside sacred religious temples.
11. Empowering ________ people to work as eco-guides helps preserve their traditional forest knowledge.
12. She bought a hand-woven silk scarf as a ________ of her trip to northern Thailand.
13. Big Ben and Tower Bridge are two of the most famous historic ________ in London.
14. Kyoto is a wonderful cultural ________ for travellers who love ancient gardens and shrines.
15. A team of marine scientists joined a deep-sea ________ to map underwater volcanoes.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 8] Improving the public bus ________ reduces traffic congestion in tourist cities.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 7] Many historic castles have been ________ and opened to the public as museums.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 6] Travelling together helps strengthen the emotional ________ between family members.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 4] Walking twenty kilometres a day on a mountain trek requires good physical ________.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Ecotourism encourages visitors to protect the local environment in a ________ way.

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Fragile historical landmarks ________ be strictly protected by law from careless tourists.
2. Visitors ________ climb on the ancient stone statues; it is strictly forbidden and carries a heavy fine.
3. International travellers ought ________ a few basic polite phrases in the local language.
4. Daily visitor numbers to the coral island should ________ to prevent ecological damage.
5. Because the museum offers free audio guides, you ________ pay extra for a guidebook.
6. Tourists should ________ respectful of indigenous customs when visiting remote mountain villages.
7. All plastic bottles must ________ out of the national park by hikers.
8. Before joining the jungle expedition, every participant ________ attend a thirty-minute safety briefing.
9. Local crafts and authentic souvenirs ought to ________ in official cultural centres.
10. If you want an authentic experience, you ________ stay in a local homestay rather than a big hotel.

Tốc độ đọc:
Trạng thái: Sẵn sàng phát Câu: 0 / 15
💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: Good morning, Emerald Bay Ecotourism Centre! How can I help you plan your island trip?
👩 Traveller: Hello! My sister and I would like to book a day excursion to the UNESCO Marine Heritage Island.
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: Wonderful choice! Because the island has a fragile ecosystem, we strictly regulate visitor numbers to 50 people per day. 💡 Đáp án câu 1: 50 / fifty
👩 Traveller: I really admire that policy! What is included in the morning itinerary?
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: At 8:30 AM, an indigenous guide will take you by kayak to see the spectacular sea caves and coral reefs. 💡 Đáp án câu 2: kayak
👩 Traveller: What about lunch? Do we need to pack our own sandwiches?
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: You don't have to bring food. You will enjoy an authentic seafood lunch prepared by a local fishing family. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: seafood / seafood lunch
👩 Traveller: And in the afternoon, do we visit any cultural landmarks on the island?
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: Yes, you will visit the 18th-century stone lighthouse and a workshop where artisans make bamboo souvenirs. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: lighthouse
👩 Traveller: Are there any special rules or local customs we must follow during the excursion?
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: To protect the fragile coral, visitors must not use chemical sunscreen or bring single-use plastic bags. 💡 Đáp án câu 5: sunscreen / plastic bags
👩 Traveller: We will definitely be respectful of those rules! Could you book two tickets for tomorrow under my surname?
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: Certainly! How do you spell your surname?
👩 Traveller: It is Morrison. That is M - O - R - R - I - S - O - N. 💡 Đáp án đánh vần câu 6: MORRISON
👨 Eco-Tour Agent: All booked, Ms. Morrison! Please arrive at Pier 4 by 8:00 AM tomorrow.
Điểm: 0/6

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Boom of Global Travel]
Every year, millions of holidaymakers travel abroad to explore famous historical landmarks and spectacular natural scenery. For many developing regions, becoming a popular tourist destination brings jobs and income to the local hospitality sector. Visitors love joining guided day excursions, tasting authentic local dishes, and buying handmade souvenirs to remember their journey.

[Paragraph B - Threats to Fragile Sites and Customs]
However, uncontrolled mass tourism can seriously damage both nature and cultural heritage. When thousands of tourists crowd into ancient temples or trek across fragile mountain trails on a busy itinerary, historic stones wear down and litter accumulates. Moreover, some travellers fail to be respectful of traditional customs, turning sacred ceremonies of indigenous communities into mere photo opportunities.

[Paragraph C - The Rise of Responsible Ecotourism]
To solve this dilemma, conservationists say that governments must strictly regulate tourism activities. Whether travellers are on a scientific expedition or a family holiday, daily visitor numbers at sensitive sites should be limited. By training local residents as eco-guides and educating tourists to respect local traditions, countries can protect their heritage for future generations.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (Task 2 Opinion & Solutions): Du Lịch Bền Vững & Bảo Tồn Di Sản

Đề bài: Write a short paragraph (65 - 85 words) discussing how governments and tourists should work together to protect cultural heritage sites and fragile natural destinations.

Tiêu chuẩn: Sử dụng động từ khuyết thiếu chủ động hoặc bị động (should / must / ought to / must be regulated), và ít nhất 4 từ vựng Unit 9 (destination, heritage, fragile, landmark, custom, indigenous, respectful, regulate, authentic, souvenir...).
